children: Aristocrat Leisure's share price has risen 7.6% over the past month, contributing to Jefferies downgrading its call to hold from buy. Aristocrat continues to consolidate market share momentum in the U.S., analyst Kai Erman says. Jefferies is also encouraged by Aristocrat expanding its market share in iGaming on the back of content releases. "However we see this largely reflected in consensus forecasts and market expectations," Jefferies says. "At 21x FY27 price-to-earnings we don't see enough upside to justify a buy rating following price-to-earnings premium to Light & Wonder increasing from 70% to 125% in past six months." Aristocrat is down 1.5% at 62.67 Australian dollars, while Light & Wonder is up 1.3% at A$124.77. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
